note: caiso-241 IS AN ADMISSIBILITY RULING FIRST AND A REPAIR SECOND. THE OBJECT (caiso-240 §3-§4): the model dispatches CAISO peakers at 2.5 / 0.8 / 0.4 % capacity factor against a measured 7.4 / 7.5 / 4.1 % -- a 66 / 89 / 90 % under-run worth -2.71 / -3.84 / -2.11 TWh, uniform across every zone and month, worsening, on IDENTICAL nameplate, which C1 passes only because the class fits inside the widened +/-8 TWh and +/-3.0 pp bands. THE QUESTION PUT FIRST, ON THE RECORD AND BEFORE ANY ARM WAS DESIGNED: is grounding CT_PEAKER's fitted `committed` band (1.350) on its own measured physical counterpart (phys_committed 0.991 = avg_committed_p50, caiso_campd_marginal_hr_summary.csv, n = 75, IQR [0.969, 1.085]) inside or outside the caiso-238 F4 / Lever-A refusal? VERDICT: OUTSIDE, on five limbs, three of them new and any one sufficient. (1) THE REFUSAL IS ROUTE-SCOPED and caiso-238 §3 said so in the assessment that ISSUED the F4 -- it covers the measured BID multiplier (CT bucket 1.166, STILL UNARMED here), while the physical min-load burn is the instrument Lever A itself used; and 1.350 > 1.166 > 0.991, so the repair's DIRECTION is invariant to which measurement route one accepts. (2) LEVER A'S OWN GROUND -- 'any avoided-startup credit belongs in an explicit UC layer, not the P1 offer' -- refuses 1.35 SYMMETRICALLY, since _CAISO_OFFER_CURVE itself calls it a 'start-cost hurdle'; reading the refusal to protect it preserves an unidentified commitment adder BECAUSE it is unidentified. (3) RULE 19 [R-ONE-MECH] DOUBLE-COUNT: the _committed tranche is the ONLY tranche carrying the bin's start cost (bins_to_fleet's docstring) and P1 already amortizes it -- $20/MW (NREL/SR-5500-55433) over the P0 run length, no CT exemption, and tranche_startup_amortization OFF on this keeper so the markup lands on the very band at issue. (4) RULE 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE]: committed = 1.35 appears in the CAISO, NYISO and NEISO CT_PEAKER curves, each comment citing the others ('NYISO-grounded' / 'NYISO/CAISO-grounded') and NONE citing a measurement, while those ISOs' own CAMPD samples read 0.843 (n=70) / 0.985 (n=18) / 0.991 (n=75). (5) THE MERIT ORDER IS INVERTED -- the predecessor keeper reads committed 1.350 > peak 1.166 = econ_high 1.166 > econ_low 1.145, i.e. the min-load block is the class's MOST EXPENSIVE MW -- and applying the refusal to ONE band of four is what inverted it, when caiso-231's measured static surface re-grounded econ/peak while withholding committed. THE REPAIR: committed := phys_committed, the value the band's own dict already carries. No new literal, no registry value to pick, ZERO FREE PARAMETERS. MEASURED PRE-SOLVE (_caiso241_gstruct_presolve.json, zero LP): exactly 44 rows move in every year, all CAISO CT_PEAKER _committed, at the exact ratio 0.991/1.350 = 0.734074074074, with offer_markup_hr driven to exactly 0.0 and ZERO rows moving in any other band, group or ISO (829.8 MW = 11.0 % of the 7,528-7,539 MW class). THE DECOMPOSITION IS THE RULE-19 ARGUMENT, NOT AN INTERPRETATION OF IT: under gas_offer_net_revenue_margin the reformed cost is phys*base_hr*fuel + (mult-phys)*base_hr*anchor, so grounding leaves the fuel-scaled PHYSICAL cost untouched and removes ONLY the fuel-invariant margin -- measured capacity-weighted at -18.6197 $/MWh, IDENTICAL TO FOUR DECIMALS in all three years across gas at 2.54 / 2.19 / 3.52 $/MMBtu. CORROBORATION FOUND AFTER THE PRECOMMIT PUSH AND LABELLED AS SUCH: MISO HAS ALREADY MADE THIS REPAIR -- its CT_PEAKER committed is 1.025 = its own phys_committed 1.025 -- and _MISO_OFFER_CURVE states limb 3 verbatim, citing FERC Order 825 / ELMP. Five of six ISOs price the CT min-load band above their own measured basis (ERCOT 1.480/1.022, CAISO 1.350/0.991, PJM 1.250/1.049, NYISO 1.350/0.843, NEISO 1.350/0.985); under rule 25 the other four are asks for their own lanes and NOTHING transfers. So this keeper is scored as B1 minus A0 (2026-09-03-caiso-241-a0-control, the same recipe at HEAD with no flag delta), and G-CTRL form 3 is a HEAD-DRIFT check. IT PASSES, and the drift it measured is EXACTLY ZERO -- A0 reproduces the predecessor keeper in every class, every year, to the last committed digit, and its C3a reads the keeper's own +4.1 / +12.6 / +15.6 %. GATES: G-STRUCT PASS (pre-solve, above), G-INERT PASS, G-CTRL PASS, G-C1 PASS, G-C3a PASS on both legs, G-C3b PASS, G-C8 PASS, G-CAVEAT PASS (1 ledgered / 0 protective), G-C6 attested. EVERY scored criterion is identical to the predecessor's; determination UNCHANGED at NOT-YET with C3a the sole load-bearing FAIL and C3c the single ledgered caveat. DIRECTION DISCLOSED BEFORE ANY SOLVE AND NEVER ARGUED FROM (rule 1 [R-STRUCT]): the direction is FAVOURABLE to the sole failing gate, which is the session's HAZARD, not its case, and the pre-registered promotion rule deliberately does not key on C3a. C3a moves -0.2 / -0.3 / -0.1 pp (+4.1->+3.9 / +12.6->+12.3 / +15.6->+15.5 %), inside the pre-registered two-sided envelope [-0.880, +0.05] / [-0.380, +0.05] / [-0.198, +0.05] $/MWh at a measured -0.0777 / -0.0426 / -0.0169. PROMOTION BASIS IS STRUCTURAL: one uncited, cross-ISO-circular scalar retires to CAISO's own measured counterpart, removing a rule-19 double-count and a class-internal merit-order inversion, at zero free parameters, with no scored criterion regressing. WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO, MEASURED AND SAID PLAINLY: the CT_PEAKER object SURVIVES the repair. Volume rises +0.206 / +0.253 / +0.148 TWh, closing 7.6 / 6.6 / 7.0 % of the miss; CT_PEAKER remains the largest single-class gas miss in 2024 (-3.58 TWh) and 2025 (-1.96 TWh) and stays below HALF the actual in all three years. Its dominant cause is elsewhere -- a separate, larger, unfunded object. THE VOLUME CEILING WAS BREACHED AND IS REPORTED AS AN ESTIMATOR DEFECT, NEVER RE-FITTED: the pre-registered crossing-envelope ceiling was 0.432 / 0.247 / 0.120 TWh and 2024 (+2.4 %) and 2025 (+23.1 %) exceeded it, because §H' counts only hours where the tranche crosses the CONTROL's price and cannot see hours that re-dispatch itself opens -- the same blindness class caiso-240 found in §H, one level up. Its PRICE leg, the registered falsifier, passed with margin. PREDICTION P-7 IS FALSIFIED: the DOF ledger did NOT move (9 entries / 6 residual, unchanged). The reason is general and worth the next session's attention -- build_dof_ledger._count_scalars counts numeric LEAVES, so a fitted->measured SUBSTITUTION is invisible to it whether or not the scalar sits inside offer_curve_by_group, because the key survives the repair.
